label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: No serás detrás de muchos a males, y no responderás sobre contienda para inclinarte detrás de muchos para torcer.
spanish: No serás detrás de muchos a males, y no responderás sobre contienda para inclinarte detrás de muchos para torcer.
readerNote: hold: clause role — the audit's own note shows לִנְטֹת has no suffix, so "you" is the subject turning aside, not an object marked by a reflexive clitic on inclinar, and the paired הַטֹּת purpose-infinitive's sense depends on that same subject/object reading, so the fix is a participant decision, not a grammar fix.
